name: HOMER
description: Carrier-grade, scalable Packet and Event Observability framework for VoIP/RTC monitoring. Captures and correlates SIP, RTP, RTCP with instant search capabilities based on HEP/EEP protocol.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Docker submodule homer-docker included. Dedicated repos: sipcapture/homer7-docker and sipcapture/homer-docker (HOMER 10). Docker-compose bundles bootstrap full deployment with HEPv3 on port 9060/UDP.

eval_notes: Leading SIP monitoring platform. Docker deployment via submodule. Good for VoIP troubleshooting and SIP analysis evals. Industry-standard SIP monitoring with 1.9k stars. HEP protocol capture provides deep visibility into call flows. Essential for observability in any SIP-based evaluation environment.
